response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive experience in software development, architectural design, and agile methodologies, with a strong emphasis on quality, testing, and mentoring. His background includes high-performance and event-driven systems, and he has experience with cloud platforms. However, his recent hands-on C++ experience is limited, and there is a critical absence of secure development lifecycle (SDL) practices or industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), which are core requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive experience in architectural design, agile practices, and mentoring.
Proven ability to develop high-performance, distributed, and event-driven systems.
Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, quality, and testing methodologies.
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience specifically with C++ in an architectural capacity.
Complete absence of secure development lifecycle (SDL) and industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443) expertise.
Lack of explicit experience in industrial automation or specific industrial communication protocols.
